name: Puzzled Hive
detailed_description:
Welcome to "Puzzled Hive", a simple-styled puzzle game set in a beehive. In this game, you will take on the role of Meo, exploring mysterious places with the help of Noth to uncover answers. Will you choose to leave?

Demo Version

We have completed the Demo (Version 0.3), which includes:

  • A basic art style has been established, with all materials hand-drawn, giving a simple and clean overall style.

  • Mechanism of switching between multiple floors.

  • Explore with your companion Noth.

  • A variety of puzzles are created with multiple mechanisms.

  • Full support for controllers.

  • Full gameplay for Chapter 1+Trail for Chapter 2.

Full Version Prospects

The full version will include 3 themes, riched maze mechanics and puzzles, different styles of scenes, more NPCs, and a full storyline. If you like the adorable Meo and Noth, or if you love playing 2D puzzle games, please don't miss it!

Words from the Developers

Hello! We are Player Links Players (PLP, which means "drifting bottle" in Chinese), a studio currently working on our first indie game. Although there are still many shortcomings at this moment, it's just the beginning. In the official version, we will do our best to create an interesting game! And special thanks to Vira Lee, who created bgm for Puzzled Hive!

Contact us

We will welcome any idea or suggestion. You can find us via:

  • Bilibili: 深名五介是在下（will update my developing progress here）

  • QQ group: 930475923

A picture of me with Meo and Noth drawn by my friend EZ to celebrate the demo launch!

Thank you for supporting us, and we are looking forward to your experience in Puzzled Hive!
